## Price per person

Net rates in USD for a group of 80 participants.

| Rate category | Price per person |

## Meals by day

| Day | Included meals |
| ---: | --- |
| 1 | Welcome dinner at the hotel |
| 2 | Lunch during the city tour and dinner at the Michelangelo tango show |
| 3 | Lunch during the Tigre excursion and dinner at a local restaurant with transfers |
| 4 | Dinner at the hotel after returning from Colonia del Sacramento |
| 5 | Traditional barbecue lunch at Santa Susana Ranch and farewell dinner at the hotel |

Drinks during included meals are charged separately unless otherwise agreed.
